note: Set A captures the page's core engineering facts correctly — the 2500 g martensite-phase and 2900 g austenite-phase wire forces, the 400 g total actuation force, the 15–20 C Irvine range, and the 32-of-64-louver actuation — while Set B omits all of them and offers only two claims. Set B's chart claim (Ms = -100 C at 53 at.% Ni) is not supported: the plotted point near -100 C sits around 51 at.% Ni and the quoted caption gives no value. Set A, however, misassigns the 30% load share to cooling (the text gives 30% heating and 12% cooling), claims the martensite-phase force is 'not specified' when it is 2500 g, and re-binds the Irvine 15–20 C climate range to the actuator assembly and building envelope. On balance A is better because it states many more correct, page-supported facts, despite its several binding and reading errors.
remarks: Both sets miss the 30%/12% heating/cooling split as stated ('30 and 12 percent ... respectively') and the fact that each bay carries two mirrored, independently acting assemblies. Set A repeats the 2900 g and 400 g facts under two entity names each. Several of Set A's quotes are truncated or paraphrased ('heating phase' for 'heated austenite phase', '2500 g' for '2500 gram load'), and the chart-derived claims in both sets rely on small plotted points that are hard to read precisely from the image.
